about_page.meta_description: Learn how MapChina connects maps, travel memory, and your digital landscape.
about_page.title: Not a collection of check-ins, but a way to understand where you have been
about_page.description: We believe travel memory should begin with a map, reflect real arrivals, and remain under the traveler’s control.
about_page.belief_title: Every place you have walked deserves to be remembered with care
about_page.belief_body_1: MapChina begins with a map of China and connects footprint, discovery, progress, and personal memory into one journey. It does not try to create more noise; it helps you see the relationships you formed with places.
about_page.belief_body_2: Account sync, map themes, and recording preferences are designed around privacy-friendly principles. Your landscape belongs to you, and sharing should remain a choice—not a condition of using the product.
